set.body: Before optimization, run the full two-fork side 256 and 1024 JDK 21 versus NumPy protocol on a quiet host and preserve JMH, NumPy, signatures, GC, and report artifacts. Add allocation-only, raw monomorphic, reusable-output, and public-operation controls so each case decomposes output allocation, planning, and traversal. Cover Double first and add representative Float and Int structural probes. Acceptance: semantic and C-layout parity; coefficient of variation disclosed; public allocation receipts; raw exact-schedule reduction lower bounds; no target is promoted from a one-fork directional run.
set.title: Freeze performance controls and lower bounds
